Entire head-to-feet figure fills the image, mighty purposeful founder rather than ordinary hill climber.
POWER: No documented magical powers; only documented gigantic stature. Physical dust and small stones dislodged exactly beneath the foot's contact with soil, no landscape-shattering shockwave or aura. [mixtecatl-c01, mixtecatl-c08]

Two plainly clothed ordinary adult witnesses, each no taller than his ankle, immediately beside leading foot and safely outside its path; knee-high-to-the-giant mature scrub trees and waist-sized rocky ridges rise behind him. His toe is as long as an ordinary person's height. These CLEAR NEARBY comparisons must be visible simultaneously in the foreground, not merely distant miniature trees. Low perspective shows the entire GIANT from huge planted feet to high head without cropping. Giant fills 85 percent of frame and dwarfs all scale cues. [mixtecatl-c01, mixtecatl-c02]
LIGHT & WEATHER: ONE warm sunset slit in dark sky rimming his face and broad shoulders; deep walnut shadows, antique gold edge light; physical dust rolls only from the pressing foot, dramatic dark clouds, not daytime flat light.
SURFACE: Coarse woven opaque tunic, weathered natural skin, tangled dark hair, gritty dust, rough barren stone; painterly tactile textures, no plastic.
SETTING: Barren rocky hills of Mixtecapan, now Mixteca. Sparse ordinary scrub trees and two adult witnesses are editorial scale cues, not a new narrative. [mixtecatl-c05]
MOOD: Respectful ancestral awe, immense and imposing, viewer compelled to look upward at the giant founder; purposeful action, never ordinary man climbing a hill, cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: Native square PNG at least 1024x1024. No text, lettering, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra limbs, heads or fingers; no film/game/anime/comic design; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, energy ribbons, floating runes, glowing eyes or invented powers. Normal-sized adult witnesses must remain tiny compared with the giant. Claim labels are not visible text.
